# The Code Less Taken

> Alternative computing, tested against present-day engineering problems.

The Code Less Taken is an independent technical publication and experimental research studio. It examines overlooked languages, systems, and techniques to clarify current problems in software design, testing, debugging, security, operations, and maintenance.

Source notes, reconstructed environments, code, benchmarks, and extended results are linked separately when they materially support an argument.

## Core pages

- [Writing](https://thecodelesstaken.com/writing/): Focused technical posts.
- [About](https://thecodelesstaken.com/about/): Purpose, audience, and editorial position.
- [Contact](https://thecodelesstaken.com/contact/): Sources, corrections, collaboration proposals, and correspondence.

## Editorial standards

- [Editorial method](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/editorial/): Topic selection, evidence, comparison, uncertainty, and corrections.
- [Corrections policy](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/corrections/): How corrections are submitted, evaluated, and recorded.
- [Privacy](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/privacy/): Site data and privacy practices.

## Feeds and discovery

- [RSS feed](https://thecodelesstaken.com/feed.xml): New posts.
- [XML sitemap](https://thecodelesstaken.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs.
